Sodium methanoate: basic (HCOO− is the conjugate base of a weak acid: HCOO− + H2O ⇌ HCOOH + OH−).

Ammonium chloride: acidic (NH4+ is the conjugate acid of a weak base).

Sodium nitrate: neutral (strong acid + strong base salt).

pOH = 3.37; pH = 14.00 − 3.37 = 10.63.
